AccessStatus.description:
Whether a source's full text could legitimately be retrieved.

The retrieval layer (E04) classifies every fetch into exactly one of these. There is no
"partially readable" state: a metered or truncated page is `PAYWALLED`, never `ACCESSIBLE`,
and nothing in the platform attempts to work around an access control.
AccessStatus.title: AccessStatus

ArticleIdentifiers.description:
External identifiers for one source, used to deduplicate results across providers.

Every field is optional: a news article usually has none of them, a journal article usually has
several. Provider-specific payloads do not belong here — adapters keep those in their own
result types (E07).
ArticleIdentifiers.title: ArticleIdentifiers

SourceType.description:
The kind of publication a source is, used as a ranking feature and a search filter.

This is a descriptive category, never a quality or credibility score: source quality is
expressed as named, explainable features (architecture proposal §9).
SourceType.title: SourceType

description:
A source the platform knows about, identified by its canonical URL.

An article is metadata only. Its text lives in :class:`SourceSnapshot` records, because text
is what has to be hashed, versioned and held immutable.

`access_status` is the latest known answer to "can we legitimately read this?"; it starts as
`UNKNOWN` for an article that has only been discovered through search.

created_at.description: When this record was first created, in UTC.
created_at.title: Created At

updated_at.description: When this record was last written, in UTC.
updated_at.title: Updated At

revision.description: Optimistic-concurrency counter; incremented by the repository on every write.
revision.title: Revision

owner_id.description: ULID of the user who owns this record.
owner_id.title: Owner Id

organization_id.description: ULID of the owning organization (school or team); None outside a tenant.
organization_id.title: Organization Id

canonical_url.description: The deduplicated, canonical http(s) URL of the source.
canonical_url.title: Canonical Url

authors.description: Author names as published, in published order.
authors.title: Authors

publication.description: Publication, journal, outlet or issuing body.
publication.title: Publication

published_at.description: Publication timestamp in UTC; None when the source states no date.
published_at.title: Published At

source_type.description: Descriptive category of the publication, never a quality score.

access_status.description: Most recent retrieval outcome for this source.
